search_text: published ZDI-15-006 ZDI-CAN-2443 ManageEngine Desktop Central MSP StatusUpdateServlet fileName File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-01-07 CVE-2014-5005 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-5005 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['ManageEngine'] ['Destkop Central MSP'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of ManageEngine Desktop Central MSP. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the StatusUpdateServlet servlet. The issue lies in the failure to sanitize the filenames uploaded to the servlet. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of SYSTEM. ManageEngine has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: http://www.manageengine.com/desktop-management-msp/service-packs.html ['2014-08-18 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2015-01-07 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Andrea Micalizzi (rgod) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-15-006/
